reconciliation.F: Accept same canonical DB and no new execution queue. Disposable-only version-pinned package exercises install/verify/disable/remove/rollback/recover. proposedConsumerMonitor.deadline: min(consent expiresAt,eventExpiresAt); no extension or new event identity
proposedConsumerMonitor.inspect: Before begin, immediately before actual dispatch and while the exact operation retains custody. Original binding/event/digest only. Read-only; never prompt/submit/rebind fallback.
proposedConsumerMonitor.denialUnknownOrOutage: Withhold future effects and request removal/stop of only the owned queued/active operation. Retain custody until actual cleanup/stop ACK, then exact finish. No timeout, disconnect, restart or elapsed lease proves physical stop.
proposedConsumerMonitor.timingLimit: A suspended or stalled client cannot promise physical stop within the polling interval. Missed checks fail closed on resumption; effectsStopped remains false until actual acknowledgement. Real timing/audibility acceptance remains unqualified.
